{{Top}}
[[File:Laser_Rifle.png|thumb|right|250px|A laser rifle]]
The '''laser rifle''' was standard issue to the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] armed forces. Its use was restricted to the best Corellian [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]]. The snipers who used this rifle generally earned fame with its trademark accuracy. Combined with the laser rifle's extraordinary power and the option to fit a scope of any size according to the user's personal preferences, this rifle was by far one of the deadliest weapons in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

Laser rifles were also used by various elite commandos during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

In [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], laser rifles were used for mining purposes. The [[Menahuun]] primitive species took over the local mines and adopted laser rifles as their weapon.<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The script for [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|the original film]] calls rifles carried by both [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] "laser rifles."<ref name="The Art of Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope]]'' {{C|1979 edition }}</ref> This term was adopted by the comic adaptation [[Star Wars (1977) 1|''Star Wars'' (1977) 1]], which was based on the script and came out before the finished film. By contrast, the later [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]] classified both these rifles as [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]]: the [[6-2Aug2 hunting rifle/Legends|6-2Aug2 hunting rifle]] and the [[Cycler rifle/Legends|Tusken Cycler]], respectively.<ref name="Card-CCG-Luke's Hunting Rifle">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Luke's Hunting Rifle}}</ref><ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Tusken Cycler Rifle">{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|cardname=Tusken Cycler Rifle}}</ref>

[[Kenner Products|Kenner]] produced a toy it called a "3 position laser rifle" as part of its first [[Star Wars (Kenner toy line)|''Star Wars'' toy line]] in 1977. The toy was modelled after the [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|rifles]] carried by the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in ''A New Hope''.
